LocoPilot VR

Drive an electric loco on the Kharagpur – Hijli – Howrah – Kolkata line at dusk. Obey signals, pass the tunnel and river bridge, and stop at every platform to let passengers board. Press P for autopilot.

  • Red signal: stop and wait for the line to clear (about 6 s).
  • Yellow: caution, a red follows.
  • Overspeed or passing red triggers an emergency brake and penalty.
  • VR: left stick throttle, right stick brake, trigger horn, grip emergency, A/X changes view.

Train models: "Intercity 125 Executive with Buffers" and "Mk 3 BR Swallow Livery - Std 1st" by timblewee (CC-BY-4.0).
